volume: Average monthly searches (third-party keyword-tool estimates; the tool's monthly series lags about 12 months). Zero means below the tool's threshold or not found.
method: Each candidate topic was expanded into two search phrases per segment; demand score = summed India + US monthly searches across its phrases. Pages are built in score order; a topic is kept only when its captured API responses are populated.
